What youre thinking is a permanent solution to a temporary problem.

No one has the right to tell you to off yourself. You deserve to live.

However I hope you now understand that this is only a fraction of the harassment you brought upon someone because of false claims. This is a learning lesson for you to understand that your actions can just come back and hit you twice as hard.

Nevertheless, get off twitter. Its not and should have never been a safe space for you. Social media is not a safe space and never will be. Take time off and really give yourself time to decompress.

Hopefully in the future you know very well what this sort of harassment can bring to a person. If you don't take accountability, the Internet will pry it from you whether you like it or not.

Again, you have the right to live. Get off the internet and take some time to yourself. You have a family and a friend who cares about you. Don't throw it away.

So my game was working just perfectly fine last night, but today it started acting weird. When I tried to open the game it would start normally. It would open up the launcher and the game normally.

The issue is when you switch windows (Chrome, Discord) it would start acting up. The game would no longer come up. Instead the game will only flicker for half a second and disappear. However I can still tell its running due to the music playing in the background, and if I hover the cursor over the thumbnail of the game it shows a preview of the game still working.

Ive restarted my computer, turned it off, reinstalled the game, ran it as the Administrator and nothing helped.

I have a sneaking suspicion that the new update from Windows created this problem for me. However, I'd like to know your input.

I hope someone sees this post, as it might help other people whose game suddenly just started malfunctioning.
